_comment: Google's Trending Now feed for one or more regions, read from trends.google.com/trending/rss with no account or key. Traffic is Google's bucket, shown as written; SEEN and LEFT THE FEED are this widget's own counts across fetches.
_geos_comment: Region codes to show, as Google's feed takes them in ?geo= - two-letter country codes such as "US", "GB", "JP". The first is shown at start; ←/→ steps through the rest. A code Google does not know is shown as rejected rather than dropped.
_refresh_comment: Seconds between fetches of each region's feed; minimum 60. Google refreshes the feed every few minutes, so faster polling shows nothing new.
